beats.spoken: Tuesday, 9:30 a.m. An email from your accountant: You use AI for your marketing copy, right? Then Article 4 of the EU AI Act applies to you.

data.place: Owner of a bakery with three shops

mail.subject: AI Act: does it apply?
lines: You use AI for marketing copy?
Then Article 4 of the AI Act
applies to you. On your radar?

beats.spoken: What do you know about your business? You use AI, but you don't build any. Article 4 says providers and deployers must ensure AI literacy among their staff. A deployer is also anyone who simply uses AI. The duty has applied since 2 February 2025.

fact.text: Art. 4 also covers deployers who simply use AI.

beats.spoken: What do you do? A: Nothing, you only use AI. B: You book an expensive certification. C: You write down which tools you use, and train the team on their risks. Remember your choice.

options.text: List the tools, train the team

beats.spoken: The right answer is C. The European Commission gives exactly this example: a business whose staff use ChatGPT for marketing copy is covered. You don't need a certificate. An internal record of the training is enough as proof.

The Commission names four questions as the minimum: What is AI and which tools do we use? Are we a provider or just a user? What are the risks of our tools? And what does each person need to know? Since August 2026, the duty is supervised.

steps.text: What is AI, which tools do we use?

beats.spoken: Understand it first, then use it. Do you have your AI list yet? Tell me in the comments.
